cases.name: filters
cases.query:
SELECT region, AGG(sales), AGG(completed_sales)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01'
GROUP BY region
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql


/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/** MAIN_QUERY { pk(region) } **/
select
	/** auto-generated by datoml: q5f20d5ef40 **/
	region,
	SUM(amount) as sales,
	SUM(
	    case
	        when status = 'completed' then amount
	    end
	) as completed_sales
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by region,
	dt_month
order by region asc;

cases.name: shares
cases.query:
SELECT region, AGG(sales), AGG(within_slice_share), AGG(all_region_share)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01' AND region = 'North'
GROUP BY region
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql

/** DML_CALENDAR { pk(dt_date) } **/
/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/*------------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       measure                      **/
/*------------------------------------------------------*/

/** #DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_7616D05 { pk(region, dt_month) } **/
if object_id(N'tempdb..#DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_7616D05', N'U') is not null drop table #DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_7616D05;
select
    region,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as sales,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as sales_minus_dim_region,
    (SUM(amount)) / nullif(SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month), 0) as within_slice_share
into #DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_7616D05
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
    and region = 'North'
group by region, dt_month;

create unique clustered index idx__r_dm
	on #DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_7616D05
	   (region, dt_month);

/** DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_747DD05 { pk(region, dt_month) } **/
with DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_747DD05 as (
select
    region,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as sales,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as sales_minus_dim_region
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by region, dt_month
),

/** DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_4095D05 { pk(region, dt_month) } **/
DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_4095D05 as (
select
    t.region,
    t.dt_month,
    t02db9.sales / nullif(t.sales_minus_dim_region, 0) as all_region_share
from DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_747DD05 t
left join #DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_7616D05 t02db9 
	on (t02db9.region = t.region or (t02db9.region is null and t.region is null))
	and (t02db9.dt_month = t.dt_month or (t02db9.dt_month is null and t.dt_month is null))
)


/*-----------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       query                       **/
/*-----------------------------------------------------*/

select
    coalesce(t1.region, t2.region) as region,
    t1.sales,
    t1.within_slice_share,
    t2.all_region_share
from #DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_7616D05 t1
full outer join DML_FACT_SALES_BY_R_DM_4095D05 t2
    on (t2.region = t1.region or (t2.region is null and t1.region is null))
    and (t2.dt_month = t1.dt_month or (t2.dt_month is null and t1.dt_month is null))
where coalesce(t1.region, t2.region) = 'North'
order by region;

cases.name: grain_avg
cases.query:
SELECT region, AGG(average_sale), AGG(average_customer_sales)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01'
GROUP BY region
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql


/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/** DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_747DD05 { pk(region) }  **/
with DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_747DD05 as (
select
	dt_month,
	region,
	SUM(amount) as sales,
	COUNT(1) as cnt,
	(SUM(amount)) / nullif(COUNT(1), 0) as average_sale
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by dt_month,
	region
),

/** DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_C_747DCE3 { pk(region, customer) }  **/
DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_C_747DCE3 as (
select
	dt_month,
	region,
	customer,
	SUM(amount) as sales
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by dt_month,
	region,
	customer
),

/** DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_747D7F9 { pk(dt_month, region) }  **/
DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_747D7F9 as (
select
	dt_month,
	region,
	AVG(sales) as average_customer_sales
from DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_C_747DCE3
group by dt_month,
	region
)

/** MAIN_QUERY { pk(region) } **/
select
	/** auto-generated by datoml: q9af8803621 **/
	t.region,
	t.average_sale,
	t73e73.average_customer_sales
from DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_747DD05 t
left join DML_FACT_SALES_BY_DM_R_747D7F9 t73e73 
	on (t73e73.dt_month = t.dt_month or (t73e73.dt_month is null and t.dt_month is null))
	and (t73e73.region = t.region or (t73e73.region is null and t.region is null))
order by t.region asc;
